ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: Another impediment is that this research is pushing in many directions, based on data sources but without integrating the new-found knowledge into overall accounts of the role of media in social change. Big data is at the leading edge of the rapidly advancing research front in the social sciences, and especially in communication research. ( ) But this research is partly limited by the sources of data, which often, though not always, come from commercial media platforms. ( ) And most of this knowledge is not being produced within the social sciences at all, but rather in the private sector and to a lesser extent in policy settings. ( ) This knowledge can be yoked to aims such as marketing, targeting populations and tailoring messages to individuals with greater accuracy. ( ) More powerful knowledge thus plays a role in everyday life, but it remains largely invisible, as when digital media users are unaware of how information is filtered for them. ( ) Big data raises certain issues in new guises, such as privacy, but the public is also adapting to the ways in which media uses are being utilized for advertising and marketing.

( ) But this research is partly limited by the sources of data, which often, though not always, come from (B)[commercial / academic] media platforms. ( ) This knowledge can be yoked to aims such as marketing, targeting populations and tailoring messages to individuals with greater (C)[accuracy / difficulty]. ( ) Big data raises certain issues in new guises, such as privacy, but the public is also adapting to the ways in which media uses are being utilized for advertising and marketing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 장애물(impediment), 상업적(commercial) 미디어 플랫폼, 더 큰 정확성(accuracy)
det.analysis:
❌ ① advantage(이점)는 원문 impediment(장애물)의 반의어
✅ ② impediment — commercial — accuracy: 원문 일치
❌ ③ academic(학술적)은 원문 commercial(상업적)의 반의어
❌ ④ difficulty(어려움)는 원문 accuracy(정확성)와 다른 의미

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 role의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A)의 role은 '역할, 기능'(추상적 기능), (B)의 role은 '배역'(연기에서의 역할)
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 역할, 기능 — (B) 배역: (A)는 지식이 일상에서 '역할'을 한다는 추상적 기능, (B)는 배우가 영화에서 맡은 '배역'
❌ ② 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (B)는 '운전'이 아니라 연기 '배역'
❌ ④ (A)는 '직위'가 아님

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to combine or bring together separate things so that they work as a whole"

det.korean: integrate = 통합하다 (별개의 것들을 합쳐 전체로 기능하게 만들다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① separate(분리하다): 정의의 반대 의미
✅ ② integrate(통합하다): 정의에 정확히 부합
❌ ③ produce(생산하다): 결합이 아닌 생산
❌ ④ filter(필터링하다): 걸러내는 것이지 결합이 아님

questions.passage: Big data is at the leading edge of the __________ (rapid) advancing research front in the social sciences.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

rapid → ____

det.korean: rapid → rapidly: 동사 advancing을 수식하는 부사 형태 필요
det.analysis: the __________ (rapid) advancing research front에서 advancing(현재분사)을 수식하려면 부사 rapidly가 필요.

questions.passage: This knowledge can be yoked to aims such as marketing, targeting populations and tailoring messages to individuals with greater __________. (accurate)
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

accurate → ____

det.korean: accurate → accuracy: 전치사 with + 형용사 greater 뒤에 명사 형태 필요
det.analysis: with greater __________에서 greater(비교급) 뒤에 명사가 필요. accurate(형용사) → accuracy(명사).

questions.passage: Another impediment is that this research is pushing in many directions, based on data sources but without integrating the new-found knowledge into overall accounts of the role of media in social change. Big data is at the leading edge of the rapidly advancing research front in the social sciences, and especially in communication research. ( ) But this research is partly limited by the sources of data, which often, though not always, come from commercial media platforms. ( ) And most of this knowledge is not being produced within the social sciences at all, but rather in the __________ and to a lesser extent in policy settings. ( ) This knowledge can be yoked to aims such as marketing, targeting populations and tailoring messages to individuals with greater accuracy. ( ) More powerful knowledge thus plays a role in everyday life, but it remains largely invisible, as when digital media users are unaware of how information is filtered for them. ( ) Big data raises certain issues in new guises, such as privacy, but the public is also adapting to the ways in which media uses are being utilized for advertising and marketing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 민간 부문(private sector): 지식이 사회과학이 아닌 '민간 부문'에서 생산된다
det.analysis:
❌ ① social sciences(사회과학): 문장은 사회과학이 '아닌' 곳이므로 반대
❌ ② public domain(공공 영역): 원문의 private과 반대
✅ ③ private sector(민간 부문): 원문 그대로
❌ ④ academic field(학술 분야): 대조가 성립하지 않음

questions.passage: Another impediment is that this research is pushing in many directions, based on data sources but without integrating the new-found knowledge into overall accounts of the role of media in __________. Big data is at the leading edge of the rapidly advancing research front in the social sciences, and especially in communication research. ( ) But this research is partly limited by the sources of data, which often, though not always, come from commercial media platforms. ( ) And most of this knowledge is not being produced within the social sciences at all, but rather in the private sector and to a lesser extent in policy settings. ( ) This knowledge can be yoked to aims such as marketing, targeting populations and tailoring messages to individuals with greater accuracy. ( ) More powerful knowledge thus plays a role in everyday life, but it remains largely invisible, as when digital media users are unaware of how information is filtered for them. ( ) Big data raises certain issues in new guises, such as privacy, but the public is also adapting to the ways in which media uses are being utilized for advertising and marketing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사회 변화(social change): 미디어가 '사회 변화'에서 하는 역할
det.analysis:
✅ ① social change(사회 변화): 원문 그대로
❌ ② everyday life(일상생활): 뒤에 등장하지만 빈칸 위치의 맥락은 거시적 '사회 변화'
❌ ③ digital innovation(디지털 혁신): 본문에 없는 표현
❌ ④ commercial marketing(상업 마케팅): 활용 목적의 하나이지 미디어 역할의 큰 맥락이 아님
det.tip: the role of media in social change = 사회 변화에서의 미디어의 역할
